title: Daniel
author: Daniel, an exile in Babylon.
date: Sixth century B.C., during exile and foreign rule.
audience: Jewish exiles and God's people under pagan kingdoms.
historicalSetting: Daniel shows God's sovereignty over kingdoms and His faithfulness to His people in exile.
keyVerse: Daniel 7:14 — "There was given him dominion, glory, and a kingdom."
christFocus: Daniel points to Christ as the Son of Man whose kingdom is everlasting and who delivers His people through suffering into glory.
outline: Visions of kingdoms and God's reign — Daniel 7-12
